SECTION I
Purpose, Scope, Basis and Definitions
Purpose:
Article 1- The purpose of this Directive is to regulate the working principles, duties, authorities,
and responsibilities of the Dental Clinic, which serves under the Directorate of Health, Culture
and Sports of Gebze Technical University.
Scope:
Article 2- This directive covers all duties, authorities, and responsibilities regarding the purpose
and operation of the Dental Services.
Legal Basis:
Article 3 - This Directive has been prepared based on the provisions of the " Implementing
Regulation for Medico-Social, Health, Culture and Sports Affairs Directorate at Higher
Education Institutions" dated 03/02/1984 and numbered 18301.
Definitions:
Article 4- In this directive, the following terms have the following definitions:
a) Directorate: Directorate of Health, Culture and Sports
b) Dental Clinic: The unit that carries out oral and dental health treat ment services within the
center
c) GTU: Gebze Technical University
d) Patient: The person who benefits from examination and treatment services
e) Examination: Intra-oral and extra-oral monitoring to detect the disease and treatment plan
f) Rector: Rector of Gebze Technical University
g) Treatment: Procedures to be taken to eliminate the diagnosed disease and problem
SECTION II
Procedures for Benefiting From, Operation and Duties of Dental Services
Procedures for Benefiting From Dental Services:
Article 5 – The following may benefit from dental services:

a) GTU staff and first degree relatives of the staff
b) GTU retired staff and their first degree relatives
c) Those with an active student enrollment at GTU
Operation:
Article 6 –
(1) Patient Registration and Admission: The dental service is provided through the online
appointment system. The patient who wishes to make an appointment cre ates his /her
appointment via the GTU Appointment Tracking System on web. When the appointment time
arrives, the patient is admitted for examination by showing his/her university ID if he/she is a
student or staff member, or by showing his/her ID card and the staff member's university ID if
he/she is a relative of a university staff member.
"Anamnesis and Consent Form" is filled out before the examination.
(2) Appointment System: If the appointment is delayed by more than 15 minutes, a new online
appointment must be made. Patients who cannot attend their appointment must cancel their
appointment via the Appointment Tracking System.
Cases deemed "urgent" by the Dentist are accepted for examination and treatment without
delay.
(3) Examination/Treatment Procedure: Examination/Treatment services are provided every
weekday between 09:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00. Before examination and treatment, patients have
the obligation to inform the Dentist about their systemic and/or infectious diseases. The Dentist
has the right to request tests deemed necessary during the treatme nt and not to intervene until
he/she sees the results. The Dentist informs the patient about oral and dental health and the
treatment process and performs the treatment if the patient accepts it. If an x-ray is required for
treatment, the patient is informed of the situation. He/she is asked to have an x-ray taken at any
health institution. Parental accompaniment is required for patients under 18 years of age.
Duties of the Dentist:
Article 7- Within the scope of o ral and dental health services, examination, and treatment of
applicants, services are provided in the form of providing necessary information and providing
advice and guidance.
Within the scope of the service, the following are provided:
a) Examination
b) Dental scaling (scaling, polishing)
c) Filling

e) Non-surgical tooth extractions
f) Fluoride application
g) Permanent and temporary bonding procedures for fixed prostheses
SECTION III
Miscellaneous Provisions
Miscellaneous Provisions:
Article 8- The provisions of the relevant legislation shall apply to all matters not covered in
this directive.
Enforcement:
Article 9-
a) This directive enters into force from the date it is accepted by the Senate of Gebze Technical
University.
b) With the adoption o f this Directive by the Senate, the "Gebze Technical University Dental
Services Directive", which is currently in force, will be abolished.
Execution:
Article 10- This directive is executed by the Rector of Gebze Technical University.
